benchmark.baseline_note: Comparison baseline is the measured issue-52 real-agent peak (614632 kB tree) plus the issue-56 anon-mmap finding. Bounded-vs-unbounded accounting here is measured hermetically in this worker; the fork-binary peak delta requires a resourced fork builder running the same harness against the bounded branch.
benchmark.method: python3 automation/memory_benchmark.py hermetic probes plus automation/opencode_bounds.py stress_bounded_capture accounting and the deterministic representative coding task

boundaries.no_provider_rewrite: Bounds work must never change provider semantics. automation/opencode_bounds.py:check_no_provider_rewrite fails closed on provider-tree rewrites and direct-client markers.
boundaries.diagnostic_context: Every bound keeps head+tail context (tail errors survive) plus a bounded file-backed retrieval path (BoundedSpool.read_window); critical error information is never hidden.
